name: Ponomaryova
source: A shy girl with a penchant for emo apparel, she enjoys sipping herbal tea and hanging out with her clique of like-minded girls. It doesn't take long for her to realize that trouble is brewing. Before long, much to her displeasure, she finds that people have started ignoring her even in the most ordinary of situations — and trying to place an order at Moonbucks has become a challenge...
